profile.headline: Microservices Developer
profile.summary:
• Visa independent 
• 15+ years in the Software Development, Web & Application Design, 
Development, Programming, Testing, Support Maintenance, and End-User support using 
Java | .NET | Delphi technologies. 
• 8+ years in cloud-native micro-services. 
• Strong skill in big-data technologies, asynchronous, concurrent, multi-threading, clustering 
techniques, logging, problem investigating and solving, optimizing and analysis of large 
datasets.  
• Proven history of implementing successful projects; Delivering advanced software solutions 
to major clients through project management, technical leadership, and key technical decision 
making. 
• Designed & led team to build micro-services, cloud native system for Rydell for searching auto 
part which serving 2M reqs/days, 6K reqs/min in rush hours. 
• Have been working with giant world-wide micro-services systems: Apple's adServing, 
Microsoft's EOP those required cross teams (US time zones, offshore) collaboration, scalable, 
high performance to server billions requests/day, big-data to analyze hundreds of TB, machine 
learning. 
• Keep knowledge upgrading with self-researches.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (@NCR)
positions.description:
Member of NCR-Psell team to maintain and implement changes for Power Sell product. This is a kitchen bundle sale system which serving multiples top US food services: BEK, Lipari, GFS …
• Maintaining 20yrs old legacy system based on Delphi and firebird
• Design and migrating system to modern technologies: Spring Boost, SQL server, React, REST, microservices architecture, docker
• Scope, design, cross-team communicate, stake holder discussion
• Implement, code review
• Mentored new members.
• Support other teams on modern technology and architecture
Technologies Used: Spring Boost, React, Delphi, SQL, Firebird, Docker
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Delphi · MongoDB · Firebird · docker · Angular

positions.title: Java Backend Developer (@Apple)
positions.description:
Member of Austin - Apple ads-platform which provide billions of ads a day to all iOS | MacOS devices. This system is giant world-wide, deployed on thousands of docker instances, handle billions request a day, analyze hundreds of TB data
• Scope, design, cross-team communicate, implement, code review for new features of
micro-services cloud native system
• Designed and implemented new service based on SpringBoot; Integrate new service
to existing system via REST API & Kafka
• Designed model for Cassandra, Implemented feature (storage & query) based on
Cassandra; Improved Cassandra query performance.
• Improved platform performance & reduce resource cost by async/non-blocking model
and Kafka based architecture.
• Analyzed releases, query and analyze logs (Splunk, Hive), review code to found root
cause of production issues.
• Mentored new members.
• Suggested better business logic to product owner.
Technologies Used: Java, Spring, Servlet, Kafka, Docker, Rio, NoSQL (Cassandra), Oracle,
AWS, Spark, Hive, Hadoop, Splunk, REST, Codahale Cymetics, Grafana, Tableau
positions.insights: Skills: java 17 · Spring Boot · Cassandra · Machine Learning · Algorithms · Python (Programming Language) · HiveQL · Oracle Database · Grafana · docker

projects.title: BidaTick
projects.description:
A fullstack self-startup project allow user bid | early buy tickets of hot events like Messi 
matches, Super bowl, Taylor Swift concerts, Black Pink concerts ... System is designed and 
implemented with cloud-native, API based & mobile friendly first based on .netcore, Jhipster.net, angular, 
REST, GraphQL, MySQL, docker, SVG … Using Copilot Github agent to implement features

projects.title: Rydell-onpart
projects.description:
Rydell – Onpart @LetterB LLC (Aug 2016 – Present): Quote handler system for Rydell, based on • SoapCore (C#, .Net Core, REST/SOAP API) ) • Multi-threading • Non-blocking/asynchronous • Micro-services based on Kafka • Mongo database • Replication • Sharding • Deployed on Kubernetes • Serving 6K requests/min, 1M request/day • Serving data from millions of inventory records across 50K zipcodes
Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GdQheMQQ8PY
